settings.title: System Failure
settings.style_prompt: anime style, cinematic lighting, detailed backgrounds, moody color grading

scenes.image_prompt: Medium shot of an anime man with dark hair sitting at a booth table inside a moving train, using chopsticks to eat steaming hotpot. Out the armored window, a ruined post-apocalyptic landscape moves past in the dark. Cozy warm interior vs cold exterior.
scenes.voiceover_text: Somewhere past the dead cities, Eli eats in silence. Warm broth, a quiet car… and nothing but ruins outside the window.
scenes.sfx_prompt: Soft sizzle of broth, chopsticks clinking against bowl.
scenes.notes: Script scene 3 (0:20–0:30): Peaceful Hotpot Dinner. Action: Eli eating hotpot while looking out the window at ruined scenery.

scenes.image_prompt: Eli caught off guard by the sound at the back of the train
scenes.voiceover_text: Suddenly he heard a loud bang at the back of the train.
scenes.sfx_prompt: sound of moving train, and a loud bang in the middle of the clip

scenes.image_prompt: Interior train car shot as overhead warm lights flicker violently, buzz, and switch to intense pulsing red emergency lights. Shadows stretch dramatically across aluminum walls, handheld camera shake.
scenes.voiceover_text: Then the lights die. [pause] Red. [whispers] Something on this train has just gone very wrong.
scenes.sfx_prompt: High-pitched digital chime, low electrical hum drop.
scenes.notes: ACT II: System Failure. Script scene 4 (0:30–0:40): Emergency Blackout. Action: Overhead lights flicker violently and turn red. The flicker, red switch and camera shake need a clip: use Generate video in the Video tab.
